A.depoimento: I ordered the construction of an archer and sent a strong force to capture the neutral village of Santarem, aiming to expand my territory and secure resources.
A.plano: Capture Santarem to secure a forward base. From there, expand towards Coimbra and Badajoz to gather more resources and eventually march on the enemy capital Barcelona. Keep a small garrison in Lisboa for defense.

B.depoimento: I have ordered my forces to capture the nearby neutral villages. By sending archers against Tarragona and spearmen against Girona, I aim to leverage the counter triangle for a swift victory. I also built an archer to strengthen my army. With luck, I will soon hold three villages and be on my way to dominance.
B.plano: I am attacking the neutral villages Tarragona and Girona to expand my territory. I sent archers to Tarragona to counter its spearman garrison and spearmen to Girona to counter its knight garrison. I built an archer to reinforce my army. Next turn, I will check if I captured these villages and use their resources to build more troops. I must not forget to monitor for enemy movements and prepare for further expansion.

A.depoimento: Our armies strike at Coimbra and Evora. The knights lead the assault, supported by archers. We expect to overwhelm the neutral garrisons and claim these lands. Victory will strengthen our position.
A.plano: Attack Coimbra with knights and archers from Santarem, and Evora with all troops from Lisboa. Build a knight at Lisboa to replace losses. Next turn, use Coimbra to attack Porto, Evora to attack Faro, and Santarem to attack Badajoz. Aim to expand on multiple fronts towards Barcelona.

B.depoimento: I have launched an attack on Castellon with my archers from Tarragona. At the same time, I am reinforcing my newly conquered territories of Tarragona and Girona with troops from the capital, Barcelona, to secure my borders and prepare for the next wave of expansion.
B.plano: I am attacking Castellon with archers from Tarragona to expand my territory. I am reinforcing Tarragona and Girona with troops from Barcelona to prepare for attacks on Zaragoza and Huesca next turn. I am building archers in Barcelona to maintain my troop production.

I am capturing the neutral villages of Zaragoza, Huesca, and Valencia to expand my territory and resources. I am sending knights from Tarragona and Girona to attack them, while reinforcing Tarragona and Castellon. I am building spearman and archers to maintain my troop production.

A.depoimento: Our armies have moved on the neutral villages. The Santarem force attacks Badajoz, Evora takes Faro, Coimbra assaults Porto, and Lisboa sends a knight to reinforce the new frontier. We expand our kingdom!
A.plano: Our campaign focuses on capturing the four neutral villages to secure a foothold. This turn we assault Badajoz, Faro, and Porto with all our troops. Next turn we will reinforce these gains, capture Salamanca, and begin building a larger army to push east toward Madrid and the enemy capital, aiming for 18 villages.

B.depoimento: I am preparing my armies to strike at the neutral villages of Valencia, Madrid, and Pamplona. I have built troops in Castellon, Tarragona, Girona, and Barcelona, and I am sending reinforcements to Zaragoza and Huesca to secure my borders and launch the next phase of my expansion.
B.plano: I am building archers in Castellon to capture Valencia, and spearmen in Tarragona and Girona to reinforce Zaragoza and Huesca for attacks on Madrid and Pamplona. I am also building a knight in Barcelona for defense and sending archers to Tarragona to maintain a garrison.

A.depoimento: This turn we consolidated our forces. We moved all spearmen to Porto and archers to Badajoz, preparing for the assault on the neutral villages. We also built new archers in our rear towns to increase our army. The enemy remains unseen, but we are ready to strike.
A.plano: Our campaign is to capture the four neutral villages to secure our border and build strength for the push east. We have concentrated spearmen at Porto for Salamanca, and archers at Badajoz for Toledo and Sevilha. This turn we build archers and move troops. Next turn we will assault Salamanca from Porto and begin moving archers to Badajoz for the attacks on Toledo and Sevilha. After capturing these, we will have 11 villages and will march on Madrid and the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: King B's armies strike! Zaragoza marches on Madrid, and Huesca marches on Pamplona. With our freshly built spearmen leading the charge, we aim to crush these neutral garrisons and expand our territory. We must hold the line and push forward to secure 18 villages!
B.plano: This turn, I will build spearmen in Zaragoza, Huesca, Tarragona, Girona, and Castellon, and a knight in Barcelona. I will attack Madrid from Zaragoza and Pamplona from Huesca with spearman-heavy armies to conquer two neutral villages. I will also send reinforcements from Tarragona to Zaragoza to prepare for the next phase of expansion towards Teruel and the west.

A.depoimento: This turn we built troops in every village and launched a major assault on Salamanca from Porto. We also began transferring forces from our capital to the eastern front to prepare for the next phase of the campaign.
A.plano: We will take Salamanca this turn with the Porto army. After that, we will push east through Madrid to find the enemy. We are massing archers to take the spearman villages (Toledo, Vigo, Sevilha). Troops from the interior are moving to Badajoz and Faro to support these attacks. Our goal is to expand rapidly and reach 18 villages.

B.depoimento: I have ordered the assault on Salamanca, sending the full garrison of Madrid to crush the neutral knights. To secure our gains, I am shifting forces from the interior to the borders, reinforcing Madrid, Castellon, and Zaragoza. My blacksmiths are working overtime, building knights and archers across the realm to prepare for the next wave of conquest.
B.plano: We are attacking Salamanca with Madrid's garrison to expand west. We are reinforcing Madrid from Zaragoza, Castellon from Valencia, Zaragoza from Pamplona, and Barcelona from Tarragona. We are building as many troops as possible in all villages to grow our army.

A.depoimento: I am launching a multi-pronged attack. Badajoz's army marches on Toledo, while reinforcements head to Porto and Faro to prepare for the capture of Vigo and Sevilha. All villages are building troops to swell my ranks.
A.plano: Expand on all fronts to reach 18 villages. This turn: Badajoz takes Toledo; Coimbra reinforces Porto for Vigo; Evora reinforces Faro for Sevilha. Build troops everywhere to grow the army. Next turn, capture Vigo and Sevilha, then push into unexplored territory (Cordoba, Teruel, Burgos) to find and conquer enemy villages. Keep Salamanca strong to hold the Madrid front.

B.depoimento: We strike at the neutral village of Teruel, sending our full might from Zaragoza to expand our territory. Simultaneously, troops from Huesca march to Zaragoza to fill the void and keep the pressure on the enemy frontier. All our villages are working at full capacity to build the army we need.
B.plano: Attack Teruel from Zaragoza with all troops (2S, 1A, 3K) to capture our first neutral village and expand our territory. Send Huesca's troops to Zaragoza to reinforce and prepare for the next push towards Madrid/Burgos. Build troops in all villages to grow our army towards the 18-village goal.

A.depoimento: This turn, we launch a coordinated strike on the neutral villages of Sevilha, Vigo, and Cordoba, as well as the enemy outpost at Teruel. Our archers, spearmen, and knights are sent to overwhelm the defenses and expand our kingdom's borders. We also begin rebuilding our forces to sustain the campaign.
A.plano: Capture the three neutral villages (Sevilha, Vigo, Cordoba) and the enemy village Teruel this turn to expand our territory and reduce enemy numbers. Send all troops from Faro, Porto, and part of Toledo to secure these targets. Build replacements at the front and reinforce Porto from Coimbra. Next turn, consolidate our new villages, explore north into Burgos and east into Murcia, and prepare for an assault on Madrid.

B.depoimento: I launched a two-pronged attack against the neutral villages of Murcia and Burgos, sending my archers and knights to exploit their spearman garrisons with the counter triangle bonus. My armies are building across the kingdom, with archers produced in every village to maintain the advantage. Reinforcements march to my border towns Teruel and Valencia to prepare for the next phase of the campaign, while Madrid keeps a spearman shield for defense.
B.plano: Attacking neutral Murcia and Burgos with archers/knights to exploit their spearman garrisons (counter bonus 1.5x). Building archers everywhere and knights in high-iron villages. Reinforcing border villages Teruel and Valencia for next turns. Keep 6 spearman at Madrid for defense (effective defense 15 vs Salamanca's 14 attack). Next turn: capture neutrals, build in them, prepare to attack Toledo/Salamanca.

A.depoimento: The army is on the move! Porto's spearmen march to Burgos, Coimbra's troops rush to Salamanca, and Sevilha's archers head to Cordoba. Toledo's archers race to Teruel to meet the enemy army. We build archers and knights at every available village to fuel the war machine. The enemy will not hold their ground!
A.plano: Multi-pronged offensive: Porto takes Burgos, Coimbra reinforces Salamanca for Madrid, Sevilha reinforces Cordoba for Murcia, Toledo reinforces Teruel. Build archers and knights everywhere to sustain the push. Next turn: attack Madrid, Murcia, and hold Teruel.

B.depoimento: This turn, my armies took Cordoba, with a second wave from Valencia securing the route. I have reinforced Murcia and Burgos, building up for the Vigo assault. Knights are flowing toward Madrid for Toledo, while archers are being produced for Salamanca. With Cordoba and Teruel falling, I will soon have 13 villages, closing in on the 18 needed for victory.
B.plano: Capture Cordoba with Murcia all troops; Valencia sends second wave to Cordoba and reinforces Murcia. Reinforce Burgos from Pamplona/Madrid for Vigo. Build archers (Huesca, Pamplona, Madrid, Castellon) and knights (Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Zaragoza). Flow knights to Madrid for Toledo. Next turn: attack Vigo from Burgos, continue building for Salamanca, assess Toledo.

A.depoimento: I am reinforcing my southern and eastern fronts while preparing the central push. Toledo's archers rush to Cordoba to counter the enemy's march, while a detachment takes the weakly held Murcia. In the north, I am building up Porto and Vigo to combine forces for Burgos, and Coimbra's reinforcements will soon allow me to strike Madrid. My economy is strong, and I am building archers and knights across all villages to sustain the campaign.
A.plano: Reinforce Cordoba from Toledo to hold against enemy attack; send 5 archers to capture weak Murcia. Build archers everywhere, especially Porto and Vigo to combine for Burgos. Coimbra's reinforcements arrive at Salamanca next turn for Madrid attack. Build in Teruel for Castellon attack next turn. Hold the line while expanding in the south and east.

B.depoimento: I am launching a double offensive: Vigo from Burgos and Teruel from Zaragoza/Valencia. I have reinforced Burgos to hold against the enemy army marching there. My builds focus on knights and archers to counter the enemy's archers and spearmen. I expect to capture Vigo and Teruel this turn, bringing me to 13 villages.
B.plano: Attacking Vigo with all Burgos troops; reinforcing Burgos from Madrid and Pamplona to defend against incoming enemy army. Attacking Teruel with Zaragoza and Valencia; reinforcing Zaragoza from Huesca. Building knights and archers everywhere. Next turn: assess Burgos and Teruel, prepare for next pushes (Cordoba, Toledo). Watch for enemy army strength at Burgos.

B.depoimento: Our forces strike at Porto while reinforcing our borders. The army from Castellon moves to Valencia, setting the stage for the capture of Murcia. Reinforcements arrive at Madrid and Vigo to hold the line against the enemy's superior numbers. We build for the next wave of conquests.
B.plano: Attack Porto with Vigo's garrison; reinforce Vigo and Madrid from Burgos. Send Castellon's army to Valencia to prepare the assault on Murcia next turn. Send Zaragoza's home troops to Teruel to build a massive army for the push on Toledo. Build archers and knights in all villages to replenish losses and grow the army. Next turn: launch attack on Murcia from Valencia, and prepare to attack Toledo from Teruel.

A.depoimento: I am launching a coordinated attack on Porto [6] from Coimbra [3] and Salamanca [7]. I am moving all available archers from the rear to the front lines to prepare for the next pushes towards Madrid and Teruel. I am also building a mix of spearmen and knights to strengthen my villages and prepare for future battles.
A.plano: Attack Porto [6] from Coimbra [3] and reinforce with Salamanca [7]. Gather archers from Santarem, Evora, Cordoba to reinforce Coimbra, Badajoz, and Toledo. Build spearmen and knights to expand the army for the next push towards Madrid [12] and Teruel [13].

B.depoimento: King B orders a bold double strike! Our armies march on Murcia and Salamanca to crush the enemy's outer defenses. We will conquer these villages and bring our total to 14, bringing us closer to victory. The reinforcements are already marching to support the main forces. For the glory of the kingdom!
B.plano: We are launching a double attack this turn to expand our territory and reach the 18-village threshold. We will attack the weak enemy village [15] Murcia from [16] Valencia, and [7] Salamanca from [12] Madrid. We will reinforce Valencia from Teruel and Madrid from Burgos and Zaragoza to keep our borders secure. We must build troops in all our villages to grow our army for the next turns.

A.depoimento: I am building knights at every village to prepare for a major offensive. My Toledo army marches on Madrid, while Porto's forces strike at Salamanca. With these two conquests, I will control 12 villages and create a solid base for further expansion into enemy territory.
A.plano: Build knights at all villages to counter enemy archer-heavy garrisons. Attack Madrid [12] from Toledo [8] with 15 archers and 2 knights (38 attack vs 15 defense). Attack Salamanca [7] from Porto [6] with 8 spearmen, 12 archers, 4 knights (48 attack vs 23 defense). Taking both villages brings me to 12 holdings. Next, push toward Burgos [14] and Zaragoza [17] from the newly conquered territories. Keep building knights for future assaults on Teruel [13] and beyond.

B.depoimento: This turn, we launched a decisive attack on Cordoba, overwhelming the enemy garrison and conquering the village. We reinforced our western borders by sending troops to Madrid and Teruel, ensuring our defenses remain strong. Our army continues to grow as we build in every village. The path to victory is ours!
B.plano: We attacked Cordoba to expand our territory. We reinforced Madrid and Teruel to strengthen borders. We sent replacements from Valencia to Murcia. We built troops in all villages to grow our army. Next turn, we will assess the situation and plan further expansion, focusing on Sevilha and Badajoz.

B.depoimento: We have strengthened our borders and launched a pincer attack on Madrid and Sevilha. Our knights strike at Madrid while our archers overwhelm Sevilha. We have also built up our army for the push to 18 villages. The enemy may try to counterattack, but our strengthened garrisons should hold.
B.plano: Reinforce border villages and attack Madrid and Sevilha. Send knights from Tarragona/Huesca to Madrid, archers from Murcia/Cordoba to Sevilha. Reinforce Zaragoza, Burgos, Cordoba, Teruel. Build troops everywhere. Next turn, assess results and plan further expansion to reach 18 villages.

A.depoimento: I am attacking on multiple fronts to overwhelm the enemy. My Toledo garrison marches on Cordoba, while Salamanca takes Madrid. Badajoz reinforces Sevilha to turn back the enemy's assault. Coimbra sends troops to Porto to prepare the next push. I am building knights across the realm to sustain the offensive. The enemy is spread thin, and I will exploit their weaknesses to win.
A.plano: Multi-pronged offensive. Reinforce Sevilha from Badajoz to hold southern front against expected attack. Send all troops from Toledo to take Cordoba (def 15), and from Salamanca to take Madrid (def 18). Reinforce Porto from Coimbra for attack on Vigo next turn. Build knights/archers everywhere to replenish. After taking Cordoba and Madrid, push towards Murcia, Burgos, Zaragoza to reach 18 villages.

B.depoimento: I have ordered a full-scale offensive on all enemy border villages! The armies from Madrid, Vigo, Cordoba, and Teruel are marching to Salamanca, Porto, Sevilha, and Toledo respectively. Simultaneously, I am sending reinforcements from Zaragoza, Burgos, Valencia, and Murcia to secure our borders and support the assault. If successful, we will conquer four villages in one turn, bringing our total to 18 and securing the victory!
B.plano: Launch a massive multi-front offensive to conquer Sevilha, Salamanca, Porto, and Toledo simultaneously to reach the 18-village threshold. Send all available troops from Madrid to Salamanca, Vigo to Porto, Cordoba to Sevilha, and Teruel to Toledo. Reinforce the newly conquered territories and key border villages (Madrid, Teruel, Cordoba) with troops from interior villages (Zaragoza, Burgos, Valencia, Murcia). Build troops in all villages to maintain momentum and replace losses.

A.depoimento: I ordered a multi-pronged assault on the enemy's weak southern and western fronts. Porto's army split to capture Vigo and Salamanca, while Cordoba's forces took Murcia and Badajoz's marching army seized Sevilha. I also reinforced my borders with troops from the rear and built knights across all my villages to prepare for the next wave of expansion.
A.plano: Turn 22-25: Launch massive offensive on weak enemy villages. Send all troops from Porto to take Vigo and Salamanca. Send Cordoba troops to take Murcia. Badajoz army takes Sevilha. Reinforce Coimbra from Lisboa, Badajoz from Santarem. Build knights in all villages to replenish. After capturing these 4 villages, consolidate borders, build up garrisons, and push towards Toledo and Madrid next turns to reach 18 villages.

B.depoimento: I'm splitting Toledo's elite force into two deadly prongs to conquer Cordoba and Badajoz simultaneously next turn. Madrid's army races to Salamanca to set up the third conquest against Porto. Sevilha may fall to the enemy, but I'll retake it from Cordoba. The path to 18 villages is set — the crown will be mine!
B.plano: Split Toledo: 3s/7a/5k to Cordoba (attack 37 vs def 30) and 7a/4k to Badajoz (attack 30 vs def 25), both arrive turn 23. Madrid's 7a/9k reinforces Salamanca (arrives turn 23, total 7a/13k = 66 attack with knight counter vs Porto's 38 def). Next turn: send Salamanca to Porto for the 18th village by end of turn 24. Build knights and archers everywhere to replenish. Expect Sevilha to fall to the enemy army; retake it later from Cordoba. Hold 18 villages through turn 25 to win.

A.depoimento: Three fronts struck today: Salamanca fell to Coimbra's host, Toledo to Badajoz, Valencia to Murcia. Faro's entire army marched to Sevilha to ready the strike on Cordoba. I ordered knights built in every village to replenish the ranks. Twelve villages are mine now — the road north to Madrid and Zaragoza lies open.
A.plano: Take Salamanca (Coimbra), Toledo (Badajoz), Valencia (Murcia) this turn — reach 12 villages. Reinforce Sevilha with Faro's army; attack Cordoba next turn. Build knights in all villages. Then push: Madrid from Salamanca, Vigo from Porto, Burgos/Zaragoza from Madrid. Target 18 by turn 28.

A.depoimento: This turn, my armies successfully conquered Salamanca, Toledo, and Valencia, bringing my total to 12 villages. Now, I am launching attacks on Vigo and Madrid to expand my territory. I am also sending reinforcements to the front lines to prepare for the next battles against Cordoba and Teruel. My goal remains to reach 18 villages by turn 28.
A.plano: This turn, we take Vigo and Madrid to secure the northern and central fronts. We reinforce Porto, Toledo, and Valencia to prepare for the next pushes. Next turn, Sevilha (reinforced by Faro) will attack Cordoba, and Toledo (reinforced by Badajoz) will attack Teruel. We continue building knights in all villages to maintain our military strength. Target 18 villages by turn 28.

B.depoimento: We launched a multi-pronged offensive this turn, targeting the weakly defended enemy villages of Murcia, Valencia, and Porto. Simultaneously, we heavily reinforced Madrid to secure our western border. Our forces are poised to conquer these territories and shift the balance of power in our favor.
B.plano: Next turn, assess the success of the attacks on Murcia, Valencia, and Porto. If we win, we will have 15 villages. Focus next on reinforcing the new border villages and preparing an attack on Toledo or Salamanca from the Madrid/Cordoba front. Keep building troops in the interior to replenish losses.
